# Sample review record

Synthetic record for the review-artifact renderer's tests. The renderer
reads only the section below.

## Review marks

| Entry | Words | Gloss | Show |
|---|---|---|---|
| review:proposed | Proposed | Put to the reviewer to confirm, correct or reject. | used |
| review:open | Open question | A question for the reviewer to answer. | used |
| review:accepted | Accepted | A decision already recorded, by the party and for the scope named beside it. | used |
| review:none | No decision recorded | No decision has been recorded on the matter named beside it. | used |
| basis | Basis | Where a marked statement comes from. | always |

| Key | Applies to | Item | Mark | Words | Value |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| XX-* | whole | review | none | No decision recorded | adoption of this guide · the reviewer |
| XX-1.2 | "two props or fewer" | review | proposed | Proposed | |
| XX-1.2 | "Every image starts from a photograph of the room." | review | accepted | Accepted | studio lead · this test |
| XX-1.3 | whole | review | open | Open question | the points listed · the reviewer |
| XX-2.1 | whole | basis | | | our test design |
| XX-2.1 | whole | review | accepted | Accepted | the registers in this plan · studio lead · this test only |
| XX-2.1 | whole | review | proposed | Proposed | the roles and figures |
| XX-2.2 | "detail photographs are optional and are added only by explicit choice;" | basis | | | our test design |
| XX-2.2 | "detail photographs are optional and are added only by explicit choice;" | review | accepted | Accepted | the optional detail photographs · studio lead · this test |
| XX-2.4 | "A move appears only where the target view includes it." | statement | | | Uses “target view”. If the reviewer leaves that term open, read “real or approved”. |

## Not read by the renderer

Anything after the next heading is ignored.
